name: prismeai-browser-extension
description: Chat with a Prisme.ai agent that always knows the page you're on.

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check sidepanel.js
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f "dist/prismeai-extension-$npm_package_version.zip" && zip -r -X "dist/prismeai-extension-$npm_package_version.zip" manifest.json background.js content.js sidepanel.js sidepanel.html schema.json icons -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.preview:notes: echo 'Upload dist/*.zip to the store with visibility = Unlisted (preview). See STORE.md.'
